assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered to capture electrocardiographic data during symptom onset.
The diagnosis code I49.9 reflects the arrhythmia.
The diagnosis code R00.2 reflects the symptom of irregular heartbeat.
The claim is for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271).
The denial is based on reason code PR-204.
